definitions.explanation: The time of year when seeds are planted. An agricultural term for the optimal period to sow crops, which varies by region, climate, and crop type.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}は{稲|いね}の{播種期|はしゅき}だ。
examples.english: Spring is the sowing season for rice.

examples.japanese: {播種期|はしゅき}を{逃|のが}すと{収穫|しゅうかく}に{影響|えいきょう}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: Missing the sowing season will affect the harvest.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}によって{播種期|はしゅき}が{異|こと}なるので、{地元|じもと}の{農家|のうか}に{聞|き}くのが{一番|いちばん}だ。
examples.english: The sowing season differs by region, so it's best to ask local farmers.

notes:
Composed of {播種|はしゅ} (sowing, seeding) and {期|き} (period, season). {播種|はしゅ} itself combines {播|は} (to sow, to scatter) and {種|しゅ} (seed). An agricultural term that appears in farming guides, weather reports during planting season, and discussions of traditional farming calendars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {播種期|はしゅき}に{入|はい}る: to enter the sowing season
- {播種期|はしゅき}を{迎|むか}える: to welcome the sowing season
- {適正|てきせい}{播種期|はしゅき}: optimal sowing period
- {播種期|はしゅき}が{遅|おく}れる: the sowing season is delayed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {種まき|たねまき}: seed sowing — the native Japanese word for the same activity, more common in everyday speech
- {田植え|たうえ}: rice planting — specifically transplanting rice seedlings into paddies
- {収穫期|しゅうかくき}: harvest season — the counterpart period at the end of the growing cycle
